entities.name: Bathtown
entities.description: Isolated trading village on the island of Stahaan, named for its hot springs.

entities.name: Istini Ayesh ni Hata Kan
entities.description: Woman nursed in Bathtown who later reunited with the ship's captain, her future husband.

events.summary: Ayesh arrived in Bathtown unconscious from a poisoned goblin blade and was nursed by Laik and Alik.
events.quote: She was nursed back to health by the brothers Laik and Alik

events.summary: Ayesh returned weeks later with another poisoned wound and was healed again.
events.quote: returning many weeks later with another poisoned wound

events.summary: Ayesh left Bathtown and the island, reuniting with the ship's captain.
events.quote: Ayesh eventually left Bathtown and the island altogether

relations.quote: Bathtown is trading village on the island of Stahaan
